ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% high-intensity (white) to 20% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) distribution across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white field across both lobes; continuous low-intensity black banding along the trailing edge; concentrated dark mottling and focal spots situated around the median notch and the base of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 1/6th of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels along the entire trailing edge; notably deep indentations are visible near the lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges and concave upward sweep along the trailing edges, creating a symmetrical tapered profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast textured pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruption (rake mark/scratch) approximately 40 pixels in length on the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization at the lobe extremities and a visible linear scratch on the right ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, 'shredded' appearance of the trailing edge boundary on the leftmost tip compared to the right.
